items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: So I had Raymond ask me to go play with him out there, see.

ctx.x: I'm talking about music. No, we had Fazola's, I'm about Fazola's. I used to go out all the time one day, it's me and Fazola's. You know, it's a funny thing, this is not about women. You know, some people are jealous of other people. So I don't have anything. But thank God that I'm not jealous about anything that anybody else is. Which is a good thing, it won't go away with it. You know, I was playing Fazola at the Greenland, see. And he had played Tony with his picture, you see there with Charlie Duke. And Tony…
